📰 Ethereum co-founder to go to Lido to discuss institutional staking: ETH at $2,493—why this could be a narrative turning point?

According to CryptoBriefing, Ethereum co-founder and Consensys CEO Joseph Lubin will attend Lido’s Poolside call, with the topic being institutional-grade ETH staking. In plain terms: a core founding team member of Ethereum personally backing the leading liquid-staking platform—aiming directly at the wallets of traditional financial institutions.

In-depth analysis

Why does it matter?

Lubin isn’t a typical KOL. Consensys has long been the infrastructure gateway for institutions to access Ethereum. His public comments on Lido’s institutional staking send signals on two levels: first, on the regulatory side, attitudes toward staking services in the U.S. appear to be softening, reducing compliance concerns for institutions entering the market; second, on the capital side, when institutions hold ETH they don’t just hold spot—they can also earn yield through staking. This makes ETH comparable to bonds for the first time in terms of asset-allocation logic.

One-sentence translation: Ethereum is switching from an “speculative asset” to an “income-generating asset,” and this call is a public endorsement of that narrative.

Impact on the market

In the short term, sentiment matters more than fundamentals. ETH is currently at $2,493, down 0.85% over 24h; BTC is ranging around $77,622, and the overall market lacks direction. A meeting preview alone is unlikely to instantly pump prices.

The medium term is what matters. If institutional staking demand materializes, it means a large amount of ETH gets locked in staking contracts, tightening the circulating supply. Reference history: after the Shanghai upgrade in 2023 opened withdrawals, the staked amount didn’t decline—instead it increased. That was the starting point for ETH’s narrative shift from a deflationary story to an institutional one.

Trading idea

- Asset: ETH (indirect beneficiary: BTC)
- Bias: Bullish 📈 Expect price to rise
- Time horizon: ETH 24 hours / BTC 12 hours

💡 I lean bullish but stay restrained: within 24 hours, ETH is likely to trade in a narrow range of $2,450–$2,550. The meeting itself doesn’t provide sufficient breakout momentum. What’s truly worth watching is whether Lido’s staking volume (stTVL) increases month-over-month after the call—if there’s no incremental gain within two weeks, then this narrative is only “good news in words,” and the thesis becomes invalid. Conversely, if BTC breaks below $77,622.01 and drags the whole market down, ETH won’t be able to hold $2,493.09 either—then the staking narrative can’t save the broader market. I’m about 70% confident in this view; the remaining 30% I leave to the market. I’m only observing with a small position.

据 CryptoBriefing，以太坊联合创始人、Consensys 掌门人 Joseph Lubin 将出席 Lido 的 Poolside 通话，议题是机构级 ETH 质押。说白了：以太坊最核心的创始团队成员，亲自下场给流动性质押龙头站台，目标直指传统金融机构的钱包。

深度解读

为什么重要？

Lubin 不是普通 KOL，他控制的 Consensys 一直是机构接入以太坊的基础设施门户。他公开谈 Lido 的机构质押，等于在两个层面递信号：一是监管侧，美国对质押服务的态度正在软化，机构进场的合规顾虑在减少；二是资金侧，机构持有 ETH 不只是现货，还能通过质押拿到收益，这让 ETH 在资产配置逻辑上第一次和债券有可比性。

一句话翻译：以太坊在从“投机资产”往“生息资产”切换，这次通话是这个叙事的一次公开背书。

对市场的影响

短期看情绪大于实质。ETH 现在 $2,493，24h 跌 0.85%，BTC 在 $77,622 横盘，整体市场没有方向，一条会议预告很难立刻拉盘。

中期才是关键。机构质押需求如果落地，意味着大量 ETH 被锁进质押合约、流通盘收缩。参考历史：2023 年上海升级开放提款后，质押量不降反增，那次是 ETH 从通缩叙事走向机构叙事的起点。

操作思路

- 币种：ETH（BTC 间接受益）
- 方向：利多📈 预测涨
- 时长：ETH 24小时 / BTC 12小时

💡 我倾向看多但克制：24 小时内 ETH 大概率在 $2,450–2,550 窄幅波动，会议本身不构成突破动能。真正值得盯的是通话后 Lido 质押量（stTVL）有没有环比抬升——如果两周内没有增量，这个叙事就只是嘴上利好，判断作废。反过来，若 BTC 跌破 $77,622.01 拖累全市场，ETH 也守不住 $2,493.09，质押叙事救不了大盘。这判断我有七成把握，剩下三成交给市场，我自己也只是小仓位在观察。

Clearpool brings institutional credit to the XRP Ledger: why is the RWA track gaining momentum?

Clearpool has launched its first institutional credit product using RLUSD on the XRPL, a move that’s positive for the XRP ecosystem and the RWA narrative.

According to Crypto Briefing, the lending protocol Clearpool has officially expanded to the XRP Ledger (XRPL), launching its first institutional credit product based on RLUSD. RLUSD is a compliant stablecoin issued by Ripple, pegged 1:1 to the US dollar. In plain terms, Clearpool has taken TradFi-style credit management and brought it on-chain—choosing a chain that’s relatively friendly to regulators, plus a regulated stablecoin. This combination isn’t random: institutions want a compliant closed-loop, not the chain with the highest yield.

One-sentence takeaway: the institutionalization of RWA has inched forward again, and the XRP Ledger narrative is extending from payments into credit.

Market impact
- Short term: XRP’s reaction is muted. In the past 24 hours, it’s up only 0.19% to $1.401, suggesting this kind of cooperation is narrative-driven and not likely to trigger immediate buy pressure. BTC $76,949.95 (-0.98%) and ETH $2,477.58 (-1.15%) are still drifting lower. Overall market sentiment looks cautious—this single ecosystem news item isn’t enough to move the market.
- Medium term: this is further evidence that the RWA space is continuing to institutionalize. The combo of compliant stablecoins and real-world credit assets is exactly the path regulators are most willing to approve, and the application-layer narrative for the XRP ecosystem is getting thicker.

My view
I’m bullish on the direction, but don’t expect the pace to be fast. This is a medium-term fundamental catalyst, not short-term fuel. XRP holding above $1.40 suggests the market isn’t treating this as bad news. Next, we’ll watch whether the overall sentiment in the RWA sector can recover and lift the group. I’m about 70% confident in this call; the remaining 30% depends on broader market conditions. If BTC continues to weaken around $76,900, then no matter how good the altcoin narrative is, it won’t help. If I’m wrong, please be gentle—I’ll only follow this direction with a small position.

【ETH makes money by lying down in a bear market—something’s off】

While many people are still watching the candlestick chart to gauge the trend, the big money has long stopped playing in that realm.

Bitmine just disclosed a set of data: it currently holds more than 5 million ETH, and it can reliably earn $334 million per year from staking. What does that mean? At today’s prices, this single item alone can cover the annualized cost of holding its ETH.

That’s quite thought-provoking.

The coin price has fallen by nearly half from its peak—so staking rewards should, in theory, shrink as well. But Bitmine is actually increasing its position, because it’s keeping a different set of books: as long as ETH doesn’t go to zero, staking rewards are cash flow, and cash flow is a valuation anchor.

Technically, the range from 2415 to 2659 has been grinding back and forth for two weeks. On the daily chart, the MACD volume is shrinking near the zero line; on the 4H chart, the highs and lows have gradually tightened, so direction in the short term is unclear. But what’s interesting here is trading volume—each time price has recently pierced through support or resistance, the volume has notably expanded, suggesting both bulls and bears are making bets at these levels.

For the bears, 2659 must be defended; otherwise, you’d be looking at 2800. For the bulls, 2415 is the psychological bottom—breaking it could trigger a chain reaction of stop-losses.

But the messages above are what’s truly worth thinking about.

Ethereum and Base have fallen out over account abstraction design, which indicates that the underlying standards competition among Layer 2s is still ongoing. Solana has increased the maximum size of a single transaction to 4096 bytes, claiming that transaction processing capacity has multiplied. Viewed together, these two things suggest that the ETH ecosystem is in a forked competition—not converging.

This directly affects developer choices. Which chain developers choose determines where the ecosystem tilts. Even if staking rewards look great, if on-chain applications can’t run, the ETH held by institutions is just a big-ticket bond.

So my view is: in the short term, the technical picture has no clear direction. But in the mid term, ETH’s valuation logic is shifting from “digital gold” toward “on-chain bonds.” Whether that can truly materialize depends on whether the staking scale can keep expanding—and whether the application layer can hold up.

What do you think? For institutions to band together to stake— is it a moat or a new bubble?

【ETH在熊市里却能躺着赚钱，这事不对劲】

很多人还在盯着K线算趋势的时候，大钱早就不在这个维度玩了。

Bitmine刚披露了一组数据：现在手里押着超过500万枚ETH，每年能从质押里稳稳拿到3.34亿美元的收入。这什么概念？按现在的价格，光这一项就能覆盖它持有ETH的年化成本。

这就很耐人寻味了。

币价从高点跌了快一半，按理说质押收益也该缩水。但Bitmine反而在加大仓位，因为它算的是另一本账——只要ETH不归零，质押收益就是现金流，现金流就是估值锚。

技术面上看，2415到2659这个区间已经来回磨了两周。日线MACD在零轴附近缩量，4H图上高低点逐步收窄，短期方向感很模糊。但这里有意思的是成交量——最近几次刺破支撑或阻力时，量能都明显放大，说明多空都在这个位置押注。

对空头来说，2659是必须守的，不然就去看2800。对多头来说，2415是心理底线，破了可能引发止损连锁。

但上面那些消息才是真正值得琢磨的。

Ethereum和Base在账户抽象设计上谈崩了，说明Layer2之间的底层标准竞争还在继续。Solana把单笔交易大小扩大到4096字节，号称交易处理能力翻了几倍。这两件事放一起看——ETH生态在分叉竞争，而不是收敛。

这直接影响的是开发者选择。开发者选哪个链，生态就往哪边倾斜。质押收益再好看，如果链上应用跑不起来，机构手里的ETH就只是个大号债券。

所以我的判断是：短期技术面没方向，但中期看，ETH的估值逻辑正在从"数字黄金"往"链上债券"迁移。能不能真落地，就看质押规模能不能继续扩大，同时应用层能不能撑住。

这事你们觉得呢？机构抱团质押这事，是护城河还是新泡沫？

📰 The tax bill is coming—yet in 114 pages they deleted the clause miners want most: why?

In the previous post, we discussed the House’s crypto tax bill. Now, according to CoinTeagraph, more details have emerged: this 114-page bill changed the taxation treatment of fees, stablecoins, and lending, but **it did not include deferred taxation for mining and staking rewards**. In other words, miners and Stakers will still have to pay taxes at the moment they receive the rewards—leaving the industry’s core demand of three years unfulfilled.💡 **Bearish**—the transmission path is very direct: compliance costs for U.S. miners and high-yield stakers remain unchanged → institutional money is less inclined to enter PoS and mining → pressure builds on both ETH staking volumes and miners’ willingness to hold coins, and in the short term this is a real emotional/positioning headwind.

One-sentence translation: They gave a little sweetness (small exemptions, stablecoin rules), but they didn’t touch the most painful part of the tax.

In-depth analysis
Why does it matter? Deferred taxation of rewards is a tax fairness issue: when you mine BTC you pay tax at the market price—if the coin price falls, you don’t get the tax back. This time it was removed, suggesting lawmakers would rather tackle easier areas first (stablecoins, lending) and avoid the core provisions that would reduce the tax base. In the medium term, cost disadvantages for U.S. mining and staking businesses likely persist, and some hashpower and staking activity may continue to move out.

Day traders have been profitable for 30 consecutive days—can this BTC rebound be trusted?

CryptoQuant data shows that BTC short-term holders have been in a state of partial profitability for nearly 30 straight days. Historically, this has often been a signal of a bull market continuation.

According to a report by CoinTelegraph, CryptoQuant’s latest analysis indicates that Bitcoin’s short-term holders (STH—cohorts bought within the past 155 days) have been hovering in partial profit for almost a full month. In simple terms: over the past month, most of the people who entered have stopped being in losses on paper. Why does this metric matter? Because STH cost basis is a key reference point for the bull/bear boundary. When price consistently stays above their cost line, selling pressure tends to ease significantly, and holders are more inclined to hold than to cut losses. At the moment BTC is trading at $76,957.98, down 1.22% over the past 24h, but the price is still moving above the short-term traders’ cost zone.

One-sentence takeaway: People who just got in recently aren’t losing money—and historically, when this happens, the odds of the trend continuing are higher than a reversal.

Impact on the market
- Short term: Continued STH profitability means panic selling pressure is reduced. There is real support around the $76,000 area. Today’s modest pullback of -1.22% looks more like profit-taking consolidation rather than a trend reversal.
- Medium term: CryptoQuant believes the probability of an enduring bullish reversal is increasing. If this 30-day profit record continues to extend, it could attract more trend-following capital back in, and the market structure is more likely to shift from ranging to bullish.

My view
I lean bullish, but not blindly. The fact that STH has been in profit for 30 days is a solid on-chain signal. Combined with the price holding the short-term traders’ cost zone, I’m 70% confident that the medium-term structure is strong; the remaining 30% is left to the market. The key is that support at $76,000 must not break—if it does, the 30-day profit record effectively resets to zero and the logic fails. First, watch whether price can hold and build volume above $78,000. If I’m wrong, feel free to be gentle—I’m only validating this logic with a small position.

ARK 趁涨抛了 6500 万美元 Coinbase 和 Circle：是看空还是调仓？

💡 Impact assessment: Neutral overall—more like taking profits and rebalancing at highs, not a bearish signal.

According to CryptoBriefing, ARK Invest reduced its holdings of crypto-related stocks such as Coinbase and Circle, totaling about $65 million.

One-sentence translation: An established institution trimmed the over-allocated portion after the rally to lock in gains and maintain target weights—not a sign of being bearish on the industry.

What’s going on

ARK has strict position discipline: if a stock runs up too much and its weight exceeds the target, it sells part of it to bring the allocation back. This sell-off happened after the market rose; in essence, it’s a rebalancing operation. In plain terms, $65 million sounds dramatic, but relative to ARK’s overall portfolio size, it’s not likely to be a major shock—it’s more like routine.

Market impact

- Short term: Slight pressure on sentiment. When the news says institutions are selling crypto stocks, retail traders’ first reaction is, “Cathie Wood is gone.” BTC is currently at $76,940 (24h -0.98%), and ETH is at $2,474.36 (24h -1.62%). Since the market is already in a pullback, this news may keep cautious sentiment around for a little longer.
- Medium term: Minimal impact. Rebalancing sell pressure is one-off and doesn’t change the industry’s fundamentals. If anything, it shows these assets rallied to the point where the institution had to reduce exposure passively.

My take

I’m inclined to treat this as noise. The real signal is whether ARK keeps net selling consistently—one-time rebalancing doesn’t explain a problem. BTC around $76,940: if it later breaks below the lower bound of this pullback range, that would be a sign of weakening trend. If it holds, then after this bearish move is digested, the market will likely continue to range. I’m about 70% confident; the remaining 30% goes to the market—if I’m wrong, please go easy on me. I only have a small position in the market to test the waters.

📰 BlackRock’s digital asset boss heads to New York for meetings: why the “corporate BTC treasury” play is becoming increasingly important?

According to Crypto Briefing, BlackRock’s head of digital assets will attend and speak at the Bitcoin Treasuries Conference in New York. In plain terms, this is a top executive from the world’s largest asset manager going on stage to endorse the model of “putting BTC onto corporate balance sheets.” BTC is currently trading at $76,940, down 0.98% over the past 24 hours.

In-depth analysis

Why is this news important?

BlackRock is not a typical institution. Its IBIT is the largest Bitcoin spot ETF in terms of scale, and its stance on BTC basically reflects the bottom-line position of mainstream Wall Street capital. When its digital assets chief steps onto the stage, the message is very clear: allocating BTC to corporate treasuries has moved from being an isolated case of aggressive companies like MSTR into a replicable asset-allocation discussion.

The core logic is this: under the narrative of a rate-cutting cycle plus the dilution of USD purchasing power, corporate cash assets need an “outlet” for “valuation anxiety.” BlackRock’s role is to productize and standardize these needs in a compliant way. This speech will very likely cover practical implementation issues such as custody, accounting treatment, and allocation frameworks—those are the real barriers keeping more companies from entering.

💡 One-sentence translation: Wall Street isn’t here to trade crypto—it’s here to help companies manage money, and the people who manage money are starting to take BTC seriously.

Market impact

The transmission path is straightforward: BlackRock speaks → increased attention from institutions and listed companies’ finance departments → inflows of ETF and corporate allocation capital → direct support for the BTC price. 大饼盘面继续无聊状态，虽有上下插针，但整体波动有限，山寨币大部分品种回落较多。

当前月线的状态自不必多说，多头继续把持局面，MACD开始缓缓翘头，明显是还没有涨完的意思。

重点还是在周线这里，周线收出个吞没形态，吃掉了上周的阳线，从图形来说还有调整的需求，下方77000支撑这里未被有效跌破，因此并未形成持续的下跌行情，还在反复拉扯的复杂震荡中运行，不过MACD已经紧贴了0轴附近，对于空头来说本周将是最好的发力时机。

日线和4小时都没什么好说的，还是处在胶着状态，市场明显是在等消息来打破局面，那么15号凌晨的CLARITY法案投票情况影响就比较大。

我花多点时间来聊一下这个事情，共和党刚提交了一个修改后的《CLARITY法案》版本，做出了不少的让步，且经过了川普的同意，这份多达630多页的修改版草案，在总统个人资产审查、地方执法介入、银行利益保护、取消刑事豁免上做出了大幅退让，旨在用这“80%的妥协”打动关键的民主党参议员，以凑齐跨过参议院辩论门槛所需的60张赞成票，市场预测通过概率应声反弹，来到了31%，所以大饼也开始反弹了一下。

我的个人判断是这样，程序性投票失败的概率还是比较大的，因为必须60票，不是简单多数51票。

共和党53席，内部还有少数反对声音，至少要7名民主党跨党支持，目前看还是很难的。

如果是这个结果，大饼大概率会直接下跌，但这个不通过的预期在市场上其实已经运行了挺长时间了，反而成为利空出尽，大饼迅速下杀后收针收回的可能性很高，因此不要看到大跌就害怕，在我们预判的73000到75000区间接货反而是很好的入场时机！

万一小概率通过了怎么办，也没关系，参议院允许进入法案辩论，可以提修正案，距离正式立法还有很远呢，并不是直接生效，离真正的落地还有几个难关要过，最终会是什么情况谁也说不好！

所以如果侥幸通过，我觉得市场会情绪性向上插针，但出现诱多的长上影再次回落的可能性更大。

上方可以进场的信号还是有效突破站稳83000之上才可以！

说了这么多，就是想让大家做到心中有数，出现对应的走势时有应对的策略，盘面波动一大，追涨杀跌，没守住胜利果实那才是真的可惜！

KULR Technology sold all remaining 764 BTC for $59M in cash, completely exiting its crypto treasury strategy.

According to CryptoBriefing, KULR, which makes battery thermal management products, announced the full liquidation of its final 764 BTC, cashing out about $59 million, officially ending its crypto treasury strategy. The reason: to refocus on its core business investments. Two days ago, we had just heard that Strive was still accumulating toward its target of 25,000 BTC—now here’s a counterexample: the same kind of publicly listed company, one side makes a modest allocation while the other exits entirely. - Short term: sentiment is bearish. 764 BTC isn’t a big order compared with BTC’s daily trading volume, but it’s a blow to the “treasury” narrative. Stock sentiment for the MSTR-related names will react first. BTC has been weak around $76,894 to begin with, so this news is pouring fuel on the fire.
- Medium term: the treasury model starts to stratify. Those that can withstand volatility stay; those that can’t exit. The market will重新 price which companies are truly long-term holders. With more exits, the premium attached to the treasury narrative will shrink.

📰 Solana transaction size cap increased threefold to 4,096 bytes: why this is paving the way for ZK?

According to CoinTelegraph, after the Solana mainnet upgrade, the maximum size limit for a single transaction has been raised to 4,096 bytes—more than triple the previous amount. In plain terms, there’s more room for data per transaction, and the main beneficiaries are developers working on zero-knowledge proofs (ZK proofs) and multisig transactions.

One-sentence translation: Solana is making space for the next-generation applications—ZK compression and privacy-focused projects no longer need to be constrained by transaction size.

In-depth analysis

Why is this news important?
ZK proofs have a natural contradiction: the proofs themselves often run into thousands of bytes, while Solana’s old limit couldn’t fit them. By mentioning 4,096 bytes this time, the official is effectively acknowledging this: ZK is the main race for the next two years, and the infrastructure has to catch up first. This isn’t a minor tweak—it’s the chain proactively compromising on its carrying capacity to match application needs.

Seen in the industry cycle, competition among Layer1s has shifted from a TPS arms race to “who can handle more complex computation.” Solana’s move is aimed at capturing developers’ minds with the Ethereum L2 + ZK route.

Market impact
In the short term, this is a technical positive, but it’s not a headline catalyst. BTC $76,808 (24h -1.29%) and SOL $100.29 (-1.25%) are both drifting lower, and an upgrade update alone can’t reverse overall market sentiment. My view is that SOL will likely trade in a stronger range bias within the 4-hour window, and outperform the broader market by 1–2 percentage points is a reasonable expectation—but don’t count on an independent trend.

The mid-term is the real focus: if ZK projects see dense deployment on Solana in the second half of the year, the SOL fundamental narrative will gain another “leg.”

Trading ideas

📊山寨币行情大分化！有的跌惨有的逆势大涨
8 月的普涨行情过后，山寨币市场正在迎来明显格局切换。不少热门公链币种纷纷回调，但也有部分标的靠着利好走出独立上涨行情，市场依旧是比特币占主导。#山寨币 
📉主流公链集体回调，利好难挡跌势
#ETH  近期小幅回落约 2%，可链上资金面并不差。上周 Bitmine 增持 28086 枚 ETH，持仓接近以太坊总供应量 4.9%；现货 ETH ETF 也录得 2.18 亿美元资金流入。Vitalik 提出 EIP‑8141 提案，优化稳定币交易，降低用户囤 ETH 付 gas 的需求，利好消息不断却没能托住币价。
#sol  同样下跌 4%，虽然上线 Transaction V1 升级，强化复杂 DeFi 交易处理能力，还有机构 DeFi Development Corp 募资 1100 万美元布局 SOL。但 SOL 现货 ETF 小幅流出，叠加大盘走弱，依旧承压。

除此之外 XRP 跌幅更大，BNB 小幅下跌 1.5%，不过 BNB Chain 在代币化资产赛道地位持续提升。JUP 表现相对抗跌仅跌 0.7%，Jupiter 手握 12.67 亿美元代币化股票，市场占比高达 44.6%，领先以太坊与 Solana。
🚀少数币种逆势突围，利好驱动行情
并不是所有山寨都在跌，部分币种凭借 ETF、供给预期走出上涨行情。 TRON 上涨 2.7%，得益于 Canary Capital 推出首款现货质押 TRON ETF；APT 大涨 6.4%，Bitwise 递交 S‑1 申请 Aptos 现货 ETF，市场看好机构入场。 KAS 更是大放异彩，单日暴涨 23%，流通量逼近硬上限 96.5%，市场不再担忧未来代币稀释问题。
⚖️市场现状：依旧是比特币的主场
山寨币季节指数目前只有 40，说明当下还是 BTC 行情，山寨季节还没到来。有意思的是，山寨币未平仓合约自 2024 年 12 月后首次超过比特币，杠杆交易十分活跃。

比特币当前报价 76751.69 美元，月涨幅超 22%，市场占比 59.29%，资金更偏爱大饼。BTC 主导率逼近 60% 关键压力位，如果后续出现回调，或许会给山寨币带来机会，但前提是山寨要突破自身关键阻力，信号才会确认。

整体来看，现在山寨币分化极其严重，不能无脑抄底，要区分利好兑现和真实资金流入。

In the mid term, the size of stablecoin supply is a foundational argument for regulatory legislation—every time Washington discusses a stablecoin bill, these kinds of data get cited.

Another “needle,” #ETH —who is this move really trying to scare?
This afternoon I was watching ETH’s chart. I saw that candle shooting straight toward 2666, and then—quickly—being hammered back to where it started. I don’t know how many friends rode a “free roller coaster” with their hearts.
The price is back around 2483. This kind of action is extremely common in today’s market: push up to lure longs, then brutally dump.
1. Don’t get into a fight with the candlesticks
That “needle” has gone down—surely trapping a batch of people who chased the price. The most uncomfortable part isn’t even losing money; it’s that helpless feeling of “it clearly looks like it’s about to break out, but it turns out to be a trap.”
But in trading, the worst thing you can do is wrestle with the chart. If you’re wrong, you’re wrong—owning it matters more than anything.
2. So what should you focus on in the current market?
With this kind of choppy, range-bound action, rather than guessing the bottom, it’s better to lock onto a few key defense levels:
First line of defense (stop-loss / observation): 2460. This is the support zone the candles are currently pulling back to. If this level can’t be held, the bears will keep probing lower—never “hold positions and hope” with longs.
Trend watershed (MA30): 2500. The yellow line on the chart (the 30-day moving average) is pressing down at the 2500 level. Until price can reclaim above this line with volume, any upward rebound should, best case, be treated as a “chance to escape,” not a “signal to add.”
3. Traders’ thoughts
Right now, the market feels like walking through mud. You think you stepped onto solid ground, only to find your foot sinks in again.
So operations recently must slow down and manage your position sizes. It’s better to miss than to make a mistake.
In this back-and-forth “painting doors” kind of market, not losing is essentially profit. Once the trend truly shows itself, we’ll move with it.
Crypto traders, don’t trade in the dark. If you want to avoid traps and keep profits steady, follow Sister Xin’s rhythm!

但交易里最忌讳的，就是跟盘面较劲。错了就是错了，认账比什么都重要。
2. 现在的盘面，到底该看哪？ 现在这种震荡行情，与其去猜底，不如盯死几个关键防守位：

It’s the same “long/short ratio,” but Binance gives you two numbers: 2.77 and 1.23—which one do you trust?

I just scanned Binance’s department of security 851 USDT perpetual contracts’ funding rates, and while I was at it, I also looked at the long/short ratios. The easiest to misread are these two metrics.

First, the funding rate. Don’t just look at the absolute value in the 8-hour line—annualize it (×3×365): ETH is currently -0.00699%/8h, which annualizes to -7.65%. A negative funding rate means shorts are paying longs; BTC is +0.00672%/8h, annualized to +7.36%. The number in the third decimal place—when annualized—is basically around 7 percentage points. That’s the real holding cost.

What’s even more worth a quick look across the whole market: among 851 USDT perpetuals, 116 have negative funding rates (13.6%), 483 are positive, and the rest are zero. The annualized median is +5.48%, but the mean is -4.22%—because a few extreme values drag the average down: ASTR (-1178%), CVC (-1108%), and HIVE (-742%). Describing “market sentiment” using the mean is like letting a few illiquid small coins represent the entire market.

Extreme funding rates are also rarely a good opportunity: there are 23 contracts with annualized absolute value ≥100% (15 negative, 8 positive). These are mostly concentrated in low-liquidity small caps and new coins. High funding rates mean someone is urgently paying to exit or抢 positions—liquidity depth for these instruments is the same order of magnitude as the cost you’ll pay when entering and exiting.

Back to those two long/short ratios: for ETH, the account long/short ratio is 2.77, and for large holders it’s 1.23; for BTC, the account ratio is 1.38, while large holders’ ratio is 2.20. One number reflects heads, the other reflects positions—so the conclusion flips completely. Any claim like “the long/short ratio shows the market is bullish” should first clarify the metric being used.

My take: I’d rather interpret negative funding rates as “shorts are crowded, longs are retreating,” not as a bearish signal. ETH’s account ratio is currently skewed long, while the positioning ratio is neutral. I’ll look at changes in position size and where price/returns fall within the range before deciding on positioning—no single indicator alone.

(I’ve turned this whole-market scan of funding rates + positioning + long/short ratios into a daily report that runs automatically every day; I only get alerted when something is abnormal.)

When you look at funding rates, are you looking at the 8-hour line, or should you annualize first? Let’s discuss in the comments.

先讲费率。资金费率别只看 8 小时那行的绝对值，要年化（×3×365）：ETH 现在 -0.00699%/8h，年化 -7.65%，负费率意味着空头付钱给多头；BTC +0.00672%/8h，年化 +7.36%。小数点后第三位的数字，年化就是 7 个点上下——这是实打实的持仓成本。

全市场更值得看一眼：851 个 USDT 永续里，负费率 116 个（13.6%），正费率 483 个，其余为零。年化中位数 +5.48%，但均值 -4.22%——因为 ASTR -1178%、CVC -1108%、HIVE -742% 这几个极端值把均值整体拉下去了。拿均值去描述"市场情绪"，等于让几个流动性极差的小币代表全市场。

极端费率也很少是好机会：年化绝对值 ≥100% 的有 23 个（负 15、正 8），基本集中在低流动性小币和新币上。费率高说明有人急着付钱离场或抢仓位，而这些标的的成交深度，跟你进出场的成本是同一个量级。

回到那两个多空比：ETH 账户多空比 2.77、大户持仓多空比 1.23；BTC 账户比 1.38、大户持仓比 2.20。一个数人头、一个数仓位，结论完全反过来。任何"多空比显示市场看多"的说法，都该先问清楚口径。

我的判断：负费率我更愿意读成"空头拥挤、多头撤退"，而不是看跌信号；ETH 现在账户比偏多、持仓比中性的结构，我会先看持仓量变化和区间位置再决定仓位，不用单一指标开单。

（这套全市场费率 + 持仓 + 多空比的扫描，我做成每天自动跑的日报，出异常才推给我。）

据 Crypto Briefing，Solowin 公布了雄心勃勃的AI基建扩张计划，目标2028年前达到100兆瓦算力规模。背景是国会那边crypto立法一直卡着不动，行业看不到明确的政策红利，反而是AI这边算力需求肉眼可见地在涨。说白了就是：一边是不确定的政策，一边是确定的企业级需求，资本用脚投票。

一句话翻译：crypto公司不是不干了，是在给自己找第二条腿。

对市场的影响
- 短期：对币价基本中性偏冷。BTC 报 $77,496 横盘，ETH $2,493.4 小跌0.7%，市场情绪没被这条消息带起来。资金层面，这类转型故事主要吸引的是股票市场投资者的注意力，不是币圈增量资金。
- 中期：如果更多矿企跟进把电力资源转给AI，全网算力供给格局会变，矿企收入结构从「币价敏感」变成「算力合同敏感」。对币圈是双刃剑——少了纯矿工的抛压，但也少了这个板块的纯crypto叙事。

我的判断
我倾向把这条读成中性偏利空：crypto原生公司集体转向AI，本质上是行业叙事在失血，政策僵局没解开之前，这类消息只会越来越多。BTC 在 $77,496 一带缩量横盘，短线看不出方向，等催化剂吧。这判断我有六成把握，说错轻喷，我自己也就小仓位观望。ETH 弱于大盘，别急着找理由。

translatedData.content:
The Bank of Russia plans to include digital currencies in prudential regulatory indicators

The Bank of Russia’s approach to regulating crypto assets is shifting from outright rejection to quantification. According to TASS, the central bank has issued a draft regulation proposing to include digital currencies within the asset scope used to calculate prudential regulatory indicators such as capital adequacy ratios for professional participants in financial markets. These rules would apply to institutions including brokers, asset management companies, foreign-exchange dealers, and cryptocurrency exchange providers. Under the draft, when calculating own funds, institutions may include only cryptocurrencies approved for trading on exchanges, and their value may not exceed 25% of the total amount of assets included in the calculation. The relevant crypto assets must also be registered and held by crypto custody institutions. The Bank of Russia said the move is intended to bring crypto-asset risks into capital regulation and enhance the financial stability of financial intermediaries.

This action is not an isolated event. Looking back, in January 2022 the Bank of Russia proposed banning the use and mining of cryptocurrencies within the country, citing threats to financial stability, citizens’ well-being, and monetary policy sovereignty—at the time, cryptocurrencies had already been banned as a means of payment. By 2026, the focus of regulation has shifted toward quota-based consolidation: on August 4, President Putin signed the “Digital Currency and Digital Rights Law,” with key provisions taking effect on September 1. For non-qualified retail investors, the annual amount of cryptocurrency purchases through a single licensed intermediary may not exceed 300,000 rubles (about $3,600). The initial list of eligible assets is limited to Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT, while qualified investors and cross-border settlements retain more room.

The size of the market helps explain the urgency of regulation. Chainalysis data shows that from July 2024 to June 2025, Russia received $376.3 billion in inflows of funds via cryptocurrencies, ranking first in Europe. Russian Ministry of Finance officials previously stated that the public’s annual crypto trading volume exceeds 1 trillion rubles and that it mostly occurs outside regulated areas. In the same period, data shows that in the first seven months of 2026, Russians withdrew approximately €24.4 billion in cash from the banking system; the incremental increase in cash in circulation in July alone hit a new intra-year high.

Logically, including digital currencies in the calculation of capital adequacy is essentially an acknowledgment that crypto assets have already appeared on the balance sheets of financial intermediaries. Rather than avoiding them, risk should be priced: if an institution holds a crypto exposure, it must match it with the corresponding capital buffer. The 25% cap and mandatory custody further constrain concentration risk. This is different from mere verbal risk warnings—it is a practical, executable prudential framework that also aligns with the categorization of crypto as a financial-market risk.

The impact on the crypto market can be viewed in layers. First, compliant channels are being institutionalized: licensed entities gain clear rules for participation, and local business shifts from gray areas into a whitelist. Second, retail customers’ annual limits coexist with a list of three eligible asset types; retail incremental growth may be constrained, and the relative position of mainstream assets could be strengthened. Third, on September 1, digital rubles will be made available to ordinary users at the same time, bringing retail payments back into the official system and pairing with the crypto investment limits.

In terms of editorial judgment, at the factual level, this draft turns crypto risk from a regulatory verbal warning into a technical issue of capital measurement. At the speculative level, it resonates with goals of controlling capital outflows and stabilizing the banking system. For the global industry, Russia provides a regulatory example in which institutionalization and quotas run in parallel; the impact is more reflected in compliance expectations and market structure than in short-term capital shocks.

content:
俄央行拟将数字货币纳入机构审慎监管指标

俄罗斯央行对加密资产的监管思路正在从排斥走向计量。据塔斯社报道，俄央行发布监管草案，拟将数字货币纳入金融市场专业参与者计算资本充足率等审慎监管指标的资产范围，适用于经纪商、资产管理公司、外汇交易商以及加密货币兑换商等机构。按照草案要求，机构在计算自有资金时仅可计入获准在交易所流通的加密货币，且其价值不得超过纳入计算资产总额的25%，相关加密资产还必须由加密托管机构登记保管。俄央行表示，此举旨在将加密资产风险纳入资本监管，增强金融中介机构的财务稳定性。

这一动作并非孤立事件。回顾背景，2022年1月俄央行曾提议禁止在境内使用和挖掘加密货币，理由是其对金融稳定、公民福祉和货币政策主权构成威胁，当时加密货币已被禁止作为支付手段。到了2026年，监管重心转向限额收编：8月4日普京签署《数字货币与数字权利法》，核心条款9月1日生效，非合格散户每年经单一家持牌中介购买加密货币不得超过30万卢布，约合3600美元，可买资产初步限定为比特币、以太坊和USDT，合格投资者与跨境结算则保留较大空间。

市场体量解释了监管的紧迫性。Chainalysis数据显示，2024年7月至2025年6月俄罗斯接收加密货币资金流入达3763亿美元，位居欧洲第一；俄财政部官员曾表示，民间加密年交易额超过10万亿卢布，且基本发生在监管区域之外。同期数据显示，2026年前7个月俄罗斯民众从银行系统提取现金约244亿欧元，7月单月现金流通增量创年内新高。

从逻辑上看，把数字货币纳入资本充足率计算，本质是承认加密资产已经出现在金融中介的资产负债表上，与其回避，不如给风险定价：机构持有一份加密敞口，就要匹配相应的资本缓冲，25%的上限与强制托管进一步约束了集中度风险。这与口头风险警示不同，是一套可执行的审慎框架，也与把加密列为金融市场风险的定性相互衔接。

对加密市场的影响路径可以分层观察：其一，合规通道被制度化，持牌机构获得明确参与规则，当地业务从灰色地带转向白名单；其二，散户年度限额与三种资产清单并存，零售端增量可能受限，主流资产的相对地位或被强化；其三，9月1日数字卢布同步向普通用户开放，零售支付被拉回官方体系，与加密投资限额形成配套。

就编辑判断而言，事实层面，这份草案把加密风险从监管口头警告变成了资本计量的技术问题；推测层面，它与控制资本外流、稳定银行体系的目标相互呼应。对全球行业而言，俄罗斯提供了机构化与限额并行的监管样本，影响更多体现在合规预期与市场结构，而非短期资金冲击。

Base and Ethereum account abstraction talks fall apart: Why must wallet standards be split?

Base and Ethereum mainnet have taken separate paths on account abstraction standards, forcing developers to choose between two sets of approaches.

💡 Impact assessment: Neutral to slightly bearish—ecosystem fragmentation in the short term increases development friction, and Ethereum on-chain app iteration may slow down.

What happened
According to CryptoBriefing, Base and the Ethereum core teams were originally working to drive a unified account abstraction standard. However, their cooperation has broken down, resulting in two competing approaches running in parallel. Account abstraction, put simply, makes wallets feel more like ordinary apps: no need for seed phrases, gas fee sponsorship, and batch operations—key entry points for non-crypto users. Now that the entry standards are split into two, wallet providers and infrastructure teams have to build separate adaptations, and cross-chain interoperability is made more complicated as well. Meanwhile, BTC is consolidating around $77,458 (24h -0.09%), ETH is at $2,488.53 (24h -0.90%), and the market is reacting rather calmly to this news.

One-line translation: The roadmap for improving user experience stays the same, but the road needs to be fixed in two directions—costs are shifted onto developers.

Market impact
- Short term: No direct shock to capital flows. ETH continues to weaken with the broader market; $2,400 is a support level in the near term, and if it breaks, sentiment will likely worsen.
- Medium term: Competition between standards, in theory, drives innovation. But Base is backed by Coinbase and has a large user base. If its approach wins, L2’s influence will rise further, adding another layer of uncertainty to Ethereum mainnet’s long-term narrative. This is a structural issue, not a price issue.

My take
Wait and watch. This isn’t the kind of news that decides tonight’s up or down move. Ethereum’s problem right now is macro liquidity, not a standards battle. I’ll just add it to my medium-term list: if by year-end the wallet experience on Base’s chain is clearly ahead of the mainnet, then that’s when the ETH valuation logic should be reevaluated. I have about 70% confidence in this view, and the remaining 30% is left to time to verify.

In the past, stablecoin trading mainly relied on Curve. Now Uniswap is taking its share of the pie with a Hook. Put bluntly: technological iteration is taking over territory from long-time players.

One-sentence translation: In this stablecoin trading “must-have” use case, more efficient pool design is reshuffling the playing field.

Market impact
- Short term: On-chain liquidity will migrate toward more efficient pools, improving ETH on-chain activity and fee consumption at the margin. But note: large stablecoin pool trading volume ≠ incremental capital entering; it’s mostly existing liquidity rotating and switching pools. ETH is currently $2,483.14 (24h -1.19%), and the near-term on-chain positive outlook may still struggle against broader market weakness.
- Medium term: DeFi competition is shifting from “token issuance subsidies” to “underlying efficiency.” That’s a healthy signal. If the v4 Hook ecosystem continues to produce high-volume trading scenarios, Uniswap’s protocol value could see a tangible lift, and ETH as the settlement layer may benefit as well.

My take
I’m mildly bullish on this news direction, but it’s a medium-term thesis—not the kind that pumps the market tonight. ETH is still churning around $2,483 in the short run. To confirm that the on-chain narrative is really taking hold, we need to watch whether over the next few weeks stablecoin pool market share continues to move from Curve to Uniswap. I’d give it a 70% chance this is the start of a trend; the remaining 30% is for the market to validate. If I’m wrong, feel free to lightly criticize—I’m only observing with a small position. If BTC $77,384 holds, there’s room for ETH’s fundamentals to improve on-chain and to amplify.
